decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The completed schedule of
site supervision and monitoring of the protection measures as approved in
condition 1 shall be submitted for approval by the LPA within 28 days of
completion of the development.

Prior to commencement of development, details
     of all proposed access facilitation pruning shall be submitted to and
     approved in writing. This will include the pruning works required in
     relation to the retained trees at the rear, which are subject to TPOs. 
     The approved tree pruning works will be carried out in  accordance
     with BS3998: 2010

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: 1499/P/1, 1499/P/2, 1499/P/3, Location Plan,  Tree Constraints Plan, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Tree Survey and Arboricultural Impact Assessment.

<p>AMS and TPP</p><p>Prior to commencement of
development, a site specific TPP and AMS based on the generic details already
provided, should be submitted for approval. Specific additional &nbsp;issues to
be dealt with:
 Details of the specialist
     foundation design to be used for the proposed rear extension. The use of
     traditional deep trench foundations within the RPA of trees is not
     acceptable. A mini-pile / above ground beam foundation must be used. 
 Specification of no-dig
     design to be used for hardstanding within RPA of cedar and oak. There must
     be no alterations in ground levels within the RPA of these two retained
     trees. Should include relevant sections to show raised levels across the
     site (which no-dig design will cause) can be accommodated
 details of all tree
     protection monitoring, site supervision, schedule of reporting and
     inspection (by the retained specialist)




d)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
Details of pre-commencement meeting between appointed arborist / site
foreman / LPA tree officer to agree on working procedures, trial digging to
agree location of mini-piles, and to confirm tree protection barriers etc are
in place before work commences. (LPA tree officer details: rebecca.farrar@harrow.gov.uk)</p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the Southern flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
description: First floor front extension, Single and two storey rear extension, Alterations to roof to raise ridge height, form hipped roof and rear dormers, Roof lights in front roof slope, Replacement windows and door in front elevation, Installation of door and window in side elevation, Extension to raised patio at rear (Demolition of rear extension)
